title: Nuclear Physics
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ are called nucleons and they constitute a nucleus.
The proton and neutron are called nucleons and they constitute a nucleus.
Fill in the blank: ______ is defined as the difference between the masses of the nucleons (M) and the atomic mass (A).
Excess mass and Packing fraction Excess mass is defined as the difference between the masses of the nucleons (M) and the atomic mass (A).
Fill in the blank: ______ is the field of physics that studies the constituents and interactions of atomic nuclei.
Nuclear Physics is the field of physics that studies the constituents and interactions of atomic nuclei.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the same as average kinetic energy of gas molecules = 0.025eV.
Thermal neutrons is the same as average kinetic energy of gas molecules = 0.025eV.
fib: ______ is a process whereby the mass number or the atomic number of target nuclei changes as a result of bombardment with projectile particles resulting in the release of energy.
A nuclear reaction is a process whereby the mass number or the atomic number of target nuclei changes as a result of bombardment with projectile particles resulting in the release of energy.
______ can be defined as the ratio of the excess mass to the atomic mass.
Packing fraction (f) can be defined as the ratio of the excess mass to the atomic mass.
______ is the energy that must be supplied to dissociate the nucleus into separate nucleus or the energy released when the separated nucleons were assembled into a nucleus.
Binding energy is the energy that must be supplied to dissociate the nucleus into separate nucleus or the energy released when the separated nucleons were assembled into a nucleus.
